questions.prompt: A genie gives you one wish. You cannot change your mind later. Which one?
options: Replay any 10 minutes of your day, once a day
Learn any skill by holding the book for a minute
Travel anywhere in the world in one second
Always know the right thing to say

questions.prompt: You have a free day. Nobody needs anything from you. What do you do?
options: Go somewhere alone, with no plan and no phone
A six-hour lunch with your favourite people
Finally build the thing you keep thinking about
On the sofa all day. Snacks. Nobody.

questions.prompt: Your closest friend did something unfair to someone you both know. You:
options: Defend them in public, tell them off in private
Tell them to their face that they were wrong
Stay out of it. Not my problem.
Quietly go and make it right for the person who got hurt

questions.prompt: Your manager makes a decision you think is wrong. You:
options: Do it their way. It is their call.
Say your piece once, then do it
Push back until somebody changes their mind
Do it your way and show the result

questions.prompt: You and a good friend want the same thing. Only one of you can have it.
options: We compete. I have already started preparing.
One of us steps back. I will not lose a friend.
We work together and go after something bigger
They can have it. I care more about us.

questions.prompt: You have 100 points for the next year. Which TWO get the most?
options: New experiences
The people I love
Doing something that matters
Peace and calm
Getting better at things
A cause bigger than me

questions.prompt: Which of these feels most meaningful to you?
options: A loud night with everyone you love in one room
A silent morning routine that belongs to nobody but you
A tradition you would cross the country not to miss
Throwing out the old way and writing your own

questions.prompt: On a group trip, you are the one who:
options: Booked nothing but your own tickets, and promised we will figure it out
Has a colour-coded spreadsheet, and a backup for the backup
Wants a pool, a plate of food, and zero decisions
Found the one strange activity nobody will forget

questions.prompt: Which behaviour annoys you the most?
options: Sweet to your face, then a group chat about you after
Says 'I forgot my wallet' for the fourth time
Being rude to a waiter
Having real talent and proudly wasting it

questions.prompt: Which of these bothers you most about the world?
options: People who cheat and get away with it
How much depends on where you were born
How fast people forget what they owe
How little respect is left for anything

questions.prompt: Your parents' advice about your life is:
options: Usually right, even when I resist
Worth hearing, then I decide
From a world that no longer exists
Something I stopped asking for

questions.prompt: What makes you lose respect for someone fastest?
options: Talking about a friend the second they leave the room
Laughing at what other people hold sacred
Taking, taking, and never once paying for the bill
Believing in nothing, so they never have to risk anything

questions.prompt: Which of these feels wrong to you, even if nobody is harmed?
options: Selling a gift somebody made for you
Working through a funeral you should attend
Selling something you know is worthless
None of these. No harm, no wrong.

questions.prompt: Which of these would you never do to a friend?
options: Cancel at the last minute because something better came up
Forget the thing they told you mattered
Not be there the one time they needed someone in the room
I have done all three. I am working on it.

questions.prompt: Which of these would you not do, at any price?
options: Sell something a relative left you
Say in public what you do not believe
Work for people you think do harm
Any of them. Money is money.

questions.prompt: How do you let a new person get close to you?
options: Fast. I tell them too much on day one.
Slowly. Trust takes a long time to build.
By doing things together, not by big talks
One to one, late at night, with real questions

questions.prompt: A stranger's opinion of you:
options: Matters more than I like to admit
Does not matter at all
Depends entirely who they are
I would rather be respected than liked

questions.prompt: What do close friends know about you that strangers do not?
options: I cry at videos of dogs
I keep a silent score against everyone my age
At 2am I am sure everyone is quietly disappointed in me
Nothing. What you see is what you get.

questions.prompt: Where do you feel most at home? Pick two.
options: Outside, moving, with weather on my face
Deep in books, ideas, and open tabs
Making music or art with my hands
Where the people, the food and the cities are

questions.prompt: What best describes your life right now?
options: Building something, at full speed
Finding my people and planting roots
Still happily figuring it out
Catching my breath after a big change
